item.text: The likely fault is concentrated around `currentPageRef` and the widget-picker callbacks: page state is updated asynchronously, while widget placement reads the ref. I’m narrowing down where that ref is synchronized and whether opening/changing wallpaper can leave it stale.

item.text: Confirmed: `currentPageRef` is initialized once and only changed by drag auto-flip, not by ordinary launcher swipes. Widget checks and placement therefore keep targeting page 0 even when another page is visibly selected. I’ll verify the exact user flow visually, then patch that synchronization point.
